price_level_identity.qualification: Conditional on owned exit level and unit path. The 17.1% exit premium is not measured from filings.

flat_exit_ASP_control.definition: Hold estimated Q4 2026 ASP flat throughout 2027, retain owned quarterly units. Persist lower CPU level into unchanged 2028 annual +25% units and +8% ASP; no catch-up. Every other revenue line unchanged.
flat_exit_ASP_control.classification: Conditional control, not an independent forecast. No value or profit extrapolation.

forecast_2028_bridge.qualification: Both Q4 2027 and FY2028 are forecast. This explains timing burden; it does not supply evidence that the exit is reached.
